title: North and South Pontotoc each add two tennis opponents in the 2027–29 realignment
excerpt: Clarksdale and Senatobia join North Pontotoc’s region. Houston and Louisville join South Pontotoc’s. The Warriors keep all five of their Class 5A opponents.

facts.statement: North and South Pontotoc will each pick up two new region opponents in tennis when the Mississippi High School Activities Association’s 2027–29 alignment takes effect. North Pontotoc adds Clarksdale and Senatobia. South Pontotoc adds Houston and Louisville. The schools will stay in separate Class 4A regions.
facts.evidence: Compared both MHSAA tennis membership lists school by school.
facts.date_context: Spring 2027 uses 2025–27 regions. New list covers school years 2027–28 and 2028–29.
facts.identities: Pontotoc, North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc varsity tennis.

paragraphs.text: North and South Pontotoc will each pick up two new region opponents in tennis when the Mississippi High School Activities Association’s 2027–29 alignment takes effect. North Pontotoc adds Clarksdale and Senatobia. South Pontotoc adds Houston and Louisville. The schools will stay in separate Class 4A regions.

For North Pontotoc, New Albany is the one familiar team in a four-school Region 2. The Vikings and Bulldogs currently share Region 1 with Corinth, Ripley and Tishomingo County. Clarksdale and Senatobia come from the current Region 3. New Albany won the Class 4A team championship in April.

South Pontotoc keeps Amory and Shannon as it moves from Region 2 to Region 4. Houston and Louisville take the spots that Itawamba Agricultural and Mooreville occupied alongside the Cougars in the current alignment. South Pontotoc will still have four region opponents.

Pontotoc High School’s Warriors, who won the Class 5A state title in April, keep all five region opponents. Caledonia, Columbus, Lafayette, New Hope and West Point appear with Pontotoc in Region 1 on both lists. Families following tennis this school year will still see the 2025–27 alignment in effect for spring 2027.
